newsitem.title: USA: American Educational plans reverse split.
newsitem.headline: American Educational plans reverse split.

text.p: American Educational Products Inc said Monday it will effect a one-for-five reverse stock split.
The split will be effective at the opening of trading on April 22. It will reduce number of common shares outstanding to about 918,000.
The reverse split is pursuant to the prior authorization of its shareholders and board.
For a period of 20 days following the effective date of the reverse split, the NASDAQ trading symbol of the stock will be AMEPD to indicate the change in the security.
